blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — At least 6,400 police officers, security forces, and civilian volunteers will be deployed across Caraga (Region 13) to ensure public safety during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, or Undas 2026, a top official said. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) director, said the security operations will run from Oct. 30 to Nov. 2, covering cemeteries, transit hubs, and major public convergence points throughout northeastern Mindanao.
